ऊर्णा

ŪRṆĀ . A wife of marīci. In the Svāyambhuva manvantara marīci had a wife called ūrṇā and six mighty sons by her. When they saw brahmā once, they teased him by calling him ‘a father who had married his daughter.’ brahmā got angry with them, and cursed them to take birth as Daityas (demons) on the earth. Accordingly they took birth as the sons of kālanemi on earth. (devī bhāgavata, skandha 4).

ऊर्णनाभ

ŪRṆANĀBHA (sudarśana) . A son of dhṛtarāṣṭra. (M.B. Ādi Parva, Chapter 67, Stanza 96). It is mentioned in mahābhārata, droṇa parva, Chapter 127, Verse 67, that Bhīmasena killed him.

ऊर्णायु

ŪRṆĀYU . A Devagandharva. He had participated in the Birth celebration of arjuna. (M.B. Ādi Parva, Chapter 122, Stanza 52). Once this Devagandharva fell in love with menakā. (mahābhārata, Udyoga Parva, Chapter 117, Stanza 16).
